notes.title: Multi-aspect ratio cards
notes.text: Photos in different shapes no longer need cropping to one. Set Cards to Carousel, pick Multi-aspect ratio under Carousel layout, and choose each card’s Image aspect ratio from 9:16 to 16:9. Each card is as wide as its image.
A saved choice from an app’s list, such as a Calendly event, no longer fails the check, and a button can open a promotion of every app again
Label turns a heading into a label
The editor’s focus ring, text styles and menus follow Material 3
The navigation rail and drawer have their own colour again
The start screen’s cards no longer sit far apart in places
